title: SSR-RACK48 48-ch SSR rack - envelope
source: OMEGA 17 x 4.5 x 1.5 in; layout from Digilent/MCC photos (see requirements.md)
_comment: General dimensions and holes only (user rule). The width is picked at x = 150, in the gap between terminal strips 1 and 2 and clear of the hole at x = 143.9. Hole pitches use the top row (y = 109.5), clear of the terminal strips. The height is to the module top (36.9); the LED domes add 1.2 to reach the given 38.1, but they are edge-on circles in the front view and can't be picked.
notes: Board 17 x 4.5 in and 1.5 in overall: given (OMEGA)

LED domes add 1.2 above module tops (38.1 overall)
